label: Zheng & Peng's own AlphaFold 3 predictions, from the paper's release
notes: NOT an arm this repository runs: scripts/07_link_paper_predictions.py symlinks the
paper's own predictions into predictions/zheng_af3_local/ so they can be scored by the
same DockQ stage, as a check on the harness rather than on a model.
It exists as a config only so the arm has a `short` like every other, and so figures
and manifests can name it the same way. `external: true` says there is nothing to
launch: it has no engine, no weights and no launcher, and run_workflow.sh never sees
it unless it is passed with --config, which would fail for exactly that reason.
Its template state and weights are whatever the paper used, which is why no figure
